title: Dots: Always-on agents
summary: OpenAI introduces Dots, an always-on AI agent system that provides continuous proactive assistance rather than waiting for user prompts. Unlike traditional chatbots that require active engagement, Dots monitors and assists users throughout their day as a persistent digital companion.
problem_solved: Eliminates the friction of reactive AI interactions by enabling AI assistants to work continuously and proactively without constant user initiation.
why_valuable: Transforms AI from a demand-based tool into a persistent intelligent assistant that can anticipate needs, monitor information, and take autonomous actions on behalf of users.
